hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; BASE="${FILE##*/}"; if echo "$BASE" | grep -qiE "^\.env(\.[a-zA-Z_]+)*$" && ! echo "$BASE" | grep -qiE "\.(example|sample|template)$" ; then echo "BLOCK: Do not edit .env files directly. Use environment-specific tooling or ask the user first." >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$BASE" | grep -qiE "^(package-lock\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|yarn\.lock|bun\.lockb)$" ; then echo "BLOCK: Do not edit lock files directly. Run the package manager install command instead." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
bash -c 'FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$"; then cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && npx eslint --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0'
